name: resume-failure-retried-once-without-resume
description: Launch resumes the folder's saved session; the CLI rejects the stale id and exits before system/init, so PowerUp starts again once without the resume flag and the fresh session takes over.
reason: A stale session id (deleted or expired conversation) makes `claude --resume` exit before init. Without the retry the person is left with no session and no way to tell why.
source: DESIGN.md core rule 'terminated … retry ONCE without resumeSessionID (covers stale session ids)'; AppState.handleTermination

script.reason: App launch: the folder's saved conversation is resumed.
The CLI rejects the stale id and exits before any init message.
The retry, started without --resume, comes up as a new session.

transcript.text: Couldn't resume the previous session — starting a fresh one.
